description: Compare park dates and ride waits for Tokyo Disney Resort, Universal Studios Japan and Fuji-Q from source-backed data.

tools.name: source_parks
tools.description: List every Queue-Times park group and park (raw; prefer the parks command for Japan parks).

tools.name: source_queue-times
tools.description: Raw live queue times for one Queue-Times park id (prefer the waits command). Required: park. Returns the QueueTimes.

params.name: park
params.description: Queue-Times park id: 274 Tokyo Disneyland, 275 DisneySea, 284 USJ, 337 Fuji-Q, 285 Legoland.

novel_features.name: Cross-park date planner
novel_features.description: See, for each date, whether Tokyo Disneyland and DisneySea tickets are on sale, few left, sold out or not yet on sale, what each ticket costs, and the hours: official for TDL/TDS (published months only), third-party ThemeParks.wiki for USJ and Fuji-Q (about one month ahead).

novel_features.name: Typical waits from local history
novel_features.description: See median and p75 waits per ride by weekday and hour from your own recorded snapshots, with sample counts and date span.

novel_features.name: Wait snapshot recorder
novel_features.description: Record the current waits for the Japan parks into a local history that later commands read.

novel_features.name: Live waits against your typical
novel_features.description: On the park day, see live waits next to the usual wait for this weekday and hour from your own snapshots, with sample counts.
